budget_comment: Measured 2026-10-14 on this shared machine with unoptimized dev/test builds, full SciFact, and cached EmbeddingGemma-2 fp32. Local budgets are twice the largest lexical or hybrid p95 across completed test and console trials, rounded up to whole seconds: collection 5658.024 ms, sqlite 601.174 ms, qdrant 670.860 ms. Corpus inference used SEARCH_EMBED_BATCH=8 and is outside query timing. Postgres and MySQL retain unmeasured provisional 30000 ms estimates because PG_TEST_URL and MYSQL_TEST_URL were unset; measure and replace those limits before relying on them. Rival relevance calibration has not run.
latency_scope: warm engine query: parsing, expansion, retrieval, query inference and fusion; fixed vocabulary; no hydration
